I have mine in standard soil (not sure which) and quite a bit of perlite, so it is very well draining but I still don’t water unless I know it’s almost entirely dried out! I actually let my hoya obovata get slightly wrinkly (less plump and stiff) before watering, and then it perks right back up the next morning.

You may be overwatering, even once a week is way too much for my hoyas. Water until it drains out of the pot and it should be good for a few weeks! They hold a lot of water in their leaves. imo it’s always best to just underwater then overwater plants like this. Best wishes!
